source.note: Antler's own directory (21 pages, Indonesia tag) + location page + careers board + official demo-day videos + the Jun 2023 / Nov 2023 / Jan 2024 batch announcements. First checks ran US$110-125K in 2022-2024; the current standard is US$85K for 10% via SAFE with up to US$250K follow-on match. Cohort ID2's funded batch (late 2022, ~9-12 names) was never published and early deaths drop off Antler's directory, so the roster is a floor.
